desc: Prove equivalence to minimizing inversions + runs over the deletion order.
Run-length encode the sequence, cap run lengths at 1/2, and characterize useful local swaps: profitable a,b,a,b and neutral a,b,a.
Derive and implement the single-anchor DP that maximizes the number of profitable swaps.
Implement the final solver with fast I/O and run compression under total N <= 2e5.
Validate on the public samples and basic edge cases; sample tests passed.
